subject: residential-tenancies-act-lqa
note: 2A, 2026-10-04. Every cross-reference made by the in-scope provisions of the Residential Tenancies Act 1987 (07-a0-00) - the s. 3 definitions they use, ss. 26A-26B, 27, 27AA, 28, 29 (so far as the bond turns on rent), 30, 31A, 31B, 31, 32, 60, 64, 65, 70, 70A and 76C - and by the Regulations in scope (rr. 5B, 5CA, 5CB, 7D, 7F, 7FA, 10AD, 10A, 11, 12I). Also entered: 'Implicit' references, to provisions the in-scope text relies on without citing them (Interpretation Act 1984 ss. 5, 61, 62, 75-76; the Act's ss. 3A, 5, 6, 61, 67, 82, 84, 85, 86B; the offence machinery), and 'Inbound' references, from provisions outside the scope list that change how an in-scope provision operates (ss. 71(1), 71(3)(b)(i), 72, 99, 100). Where one reference is made from several places, 'from' lists them. All at depth 1: the Regulations named are inside the scope, so the references they make are first-step references. Module names are proposals; nothing is encoded yet (4A). References between in-scope provisions are entered too, as encoded.
